description_part1: ... the friendly and adventurous ginger cat with a heart as fiery as his fur! Trace is always on the move, exploring new places and turning every corner into his personal playground.
description_part2: Trace loves to explore and meet new people. He's a social cat who enjoys the company of humans and other animals alike.
description_part3: When you meet Trace, you can check him in here. This helps his owner know where he's been and that he's safe.
description_checkin: Check Trace in. You have met Trace and are okay with giving the coordinates to me and the rest of the world – Only GPS coordinates and the name will be stored.
description_checkin_2: The check-in will be stored in a database and can be viewed on a map. You can also add a comment about your meeting with Trace.
